items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: And we met Antonio Carlos Jobim, we met Joao Gilberto, we met Carlos Lyra, Edu Lobo, and Astrud was married to Joao at the time, and they came over with their little child

ctx.x: Because he had been in Brazil with Tony Bennett.

And they’d come to his house and he’d bring them over to our house, and we had several sessions with them playing in our dining room. And we met Antonio Carlos Jobim, we met Joao Gilberto, we met Carlos Lyra, Edu Lobo, and Astrud was married to Joao at the time, and they came over with their little child, and I mean we met all these people, it was great, just wonderful.
Boy you have had some angelic guidance along the way.
